Ce soutien comprendra la qualification et l’évolution des premiers contacts, la préparation de devis budgétaires, le suivi des prospects potentiels jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient prêts pour la vente, ainsi que des tâches administratives afin d’assurer des processus d’affaires fluides et efficaces.
Responsabilités
Qualifier tous les leads entrants et les répartir, conformément aux règles et directives établies, auprès du gestionnaire de comptes désigné sur le territoire.
En collaboration avec les responsables des ventes et les équipes commerciales terrain du territoire, participer à des appels de qualification conjoints lorsque nécessaire afin d’atteindre les objectifs annuels.
Être capable d’identifier une opportunité de vente valide et de suivre des étapes clairement définies avec les leads entrants, afin d’assurer une qualification dans les délais appropriés.
En lien avec les objectifs du responsable des ventes, participer aux réunions de prévision et autres réunions commerciales si nécessaire, y compris l’alignement sur les objectifs de commandes et sur la façon de les dépasser.
Devenir expert(e) de Salesforce et des autres outils utilisés pour améliorer l’efficacité des ventes, et adopter de nouvelles stratégies/techniques de vente lorsque demandé.
Maîtriser les caractéristiques, avantages, spécifications et propositions de valeur des produits techniques de Malvern Panalytical afin d’échanger à un niveau approprié avec des scientifiques, ingénieurs et universitaires dans divers domaines.
Entretenir des relations à long terme avec les clients existants et acquérir de nouveaux clients, notamment dans les principaux domaines de caractérisation des particules (diffraction laser, diffusion dynamique de la lumière, analyse d’image, microcalorimétrie, XRF, XRD, NIR, services d’analyses).
Fournir un soutien à l’équipe Inside Sales EMEA selon les besoins, tout en respectant les indicateurs de performance établis.

Vous êtes une personne dotée d’un fort sens commercial, avec un haut niveau de réactivité et prête à aller au-delà des attentes.
Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences en communication orale, en écoute et en questionnement, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension de nos produits et de leur utilisation dans des environnements industriels et académiques.
A un impact sur la croissance des activités de Malvern Panalytical au niveau régional. Contribue à l’image professionnelle de Malvern Panalytical .
A un impact sur la satisfaction client.
Indicateurs du pipeline de la demande : MQLs, opportunités, chiffre d’affaires.
Expérience avérée dans l’accélération efficace du pipeline, la qualification et les programmes de maturation des prospects.
Grande attention aux détails, solides compétences en gestion du temps et en organisation. Les compétences en langues étrangères et en marketing de sites web non anglophones sont un atout.
Connaissances à jour des tendances et des évolutions en marketing B-to-B.
Niveau de connaissances et/ou expérience
Vous détenez un baccalauréat en sciences (B. Sc.) ou un diplôme supérieur, ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience en biologie générale, biochimie, chimie, physique, génie chimique ou science des matériaux.
Deux à quatre années d’expérience pertinente en ventes/applications et/ou formation.
La maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit, oral et compréhension) est essentielle pour ce rôle, le gestionnaire étant basé aux États-Unis et le poste impliquant des interactions avec des clients potentiels à travers le Canada ainsi qu’avec des collègues situés dans différentes régions du monde.
Compétences et aptitudes
Motivation personnelle et ambition d’évoluer dans le poste ; expérience en vente technique / services analytiques / organismes de recherche sous contrat (une expérience dans les sciences de la vie / l’industrie pharmaceutique est un atout).
Capacité à discuter et à vendre des services.

Nous valorisons l’esprit d’initiative et l’engagement en offrant de réelles opportunités de carrière.
Lorsque vous rejoignez notre entreprise, vous faites partie d’une organisation en croissance où vous pouvez contribuer à façonner l’avenir de nos processus de travail.
Nous offrons un programme de rémunération concurrentiel. Nos avantages comprennent une assurance médicale, dentaire, de la vue et d’invalidité, un REER collectif avec participation de l’employeur, accès à la télémédecine ainsi qu’à un programme d’aide aux employés (PAE).

s.h: About us - Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics and SciAps.
s.t:
Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.
We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.
Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.
Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.
SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.
We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.
We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Precision is at the heart of what we do – our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.
Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics & SciAps
Your Partners in Discovery

About Ceros
At Ceros, you’ll help ambitious brands create digital experiences that people actually want to explore. Our platform gives marketers and designers the flexibility to design, build, and publish immersive content. All without code. With Ceros, teams move faster, scale smarter, and deliver work that makes a real impact.
Customers report engagement times that are 80% longer and conversion rates more than 20% higher on Ceros-built experiences. That kind of performance is why leading brands like Pepsi, TimeOut, and Mastercard rely on us. Working here means shaping the future of digital experiences and joining a team that values bold ideas, creativity, and purpose-driven work.

Sr. SDRs at Ceros are high-performing outbound sellers who blend grit, creativity, and AI-powered tools to build pipeline at scale. Having mastered the core skills of the Outbound SDR role, you are now ready to operate at the intersection of human strategy and machine efficiency.
Functionally, you are given full autonomy to drive opportunities within your pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting. While you will spend a significant portion of your day on high-value human tasks like strategic cold calling, you will be supported by a tech stack that automates repetitive tasks.

You will be responsible for managing AI agents - helping to build, test, and refine their outputs - while sharing fresh insights to help the team evolve. You aren't just using ChatGPT to "fix your grammar"; you are a curious architect of AI workflows, comfortable oscillating between 5-6 different AI-driven platforms to amplify your output.
Success in this role means exceeding targets through a blend of grit and technological sophistication. Your role will work closely with New Business Directors to help them close and win business on a set of industry-specific target accounts. While you are responsible for the top of funnel pipeline sourcing, your NBD will focus on running calls and closing deals.
This role is designed for those who have ambition to progress into Sales, Customer Success, or Strategic Accounts within 12-24 months by demonstrating they can lead in the new era of AI-integrated sales. This is a fully outbound SDR role.

Pipeline Generation & Acceleration: Build and maintain a pipeline of Outbound qualified leads, achieving quotas by leveraging AI for high-velocity prospecting.
Cold Calling: Responsible for spending 3-4 hours a day prospecting via cold calling to source meetings for your New Business Director.
AI Orchestration: You will manage multiple vendor-forward and homegrown AI tools, moving seamlessly between platforms to optimize your workflow.
Agent Management: Take ownership of AI agents. You will be responsible for the creativity behind their deployment, monitoring their performance, and auditing their output to ensure brand alignment.
Strategic Outreach: Generate qualified Outbound meetings for our new business pod through sophisticated, high-touch phone, LinkedIn, and email outreach.
CRM Cleanliness and Tooling Upkeep: Manage the hand-off to sales executives and maintain pristine data integrity within our Hubspot CRM.
Practical Stuff We Anticipate You Having
1-3 years of Outbound SDR/Sales experience with a proven track record of hitting targets.
The ability to spend 3+ hours a day on the phone. Because AI handles your admin (list building, research, and data entry), your calling time must be high-energy and high-impact.
A strong curiosity about how AI is shaping modern sales. You’re comfortable leveraging the AI capabilities within tools beyond ChatGPT and Gemini, like Common Room, Amplemarket, Clay, or similar platforms, and you’re eager to experiment with new AI tools that streamline your process and make your workflows more efficient.
Ability to write strategic emails and converse professionally with C-suite and VP-level executives.
A willingness to work with others across the sales team and a desire to help build the future of the Ceros sales engine.
A "start-up soul" that thrives in a changing environment with an ever-evolving AI-forward product.
Note: This is not a traditional “data entry” SDR role. We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about AI tooling and excited about how automation can elevate and empower the sales process. If you’re energized by high-volume prospecting and leveraging innovative technology to work smarter and drive impact, you’ll thrive in this role.

About Concurrence
At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre-visit intake, care navigation, post-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.
This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction.

Unlike single-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case.
Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures.
We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you.

Our Core Values
Patients Win, We Win
If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
High Standards, High Care
We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them.
Thoughtful Urgency
We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
Intensely Measured
We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.
Who Builds With Us
Low ego: Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
Direct: You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
High agency: You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
Bar of excellence: You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
Skeptical: You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.
